# Comprehensive Knowledge Base — Jóga seberozvoje (Kateřina Hlavičková)

## Overview
Jóga seberozvoje is an authentic somatic yoga practice and personal development approach located in Prague, Czech Republic. It focuses on gentle posture work, functional biomechanics, pranayama (breathwork), and nervous system regulation (vagus nerve support, stress relief).

## Services Breakdown

### 1. Ochutnávková lekce (Taster Session)
- Duration: 75 minutes
- Format: Individual 1:1 (In-person in Prague or Online via Zoom)
- Includes: Individual consultation, custom somatic movement, breath assessment, guided relaxation.
- Goal: Experiencing Kateřina's teaching style and finding your baseline.

### 2. Kořeny — Individuální program (Roots - 1:1 Individual Program)
- Duration: 8 weeks (weekly sessions + home integration support)
- Format: 1:1 Mentoring
- Focus: Building nervous system resilience, emotional clarity, habit integration, and deep personal practice.

### 3. Rovnováha — Skupinový kurz (Balance - Group Course)
- Format: Live guided group sessions
- Focus: Community practice, stress relief techniques, nervous system balancing.

### 4. Pět minut ráno (Free Somatic Morning Practice)
- Format: Free Audio (MP3) + PDF Psychosomatic Breathing Guide
- Access: Instant unlock via name and email subscription.
